title: item.label not present for Range under CurrentRefinement
body: My Range component is the same that the component provided in the documentation.. I suppose that we missed associate `label` field 😄 live demo at https://windtoday.co

comments.body: Could be possible modify Range implementation to works as expected? looks a little tricky

In the code that you paste, `category` match with `attributeName` and also is present in the Range and not associated with the label so I suppose that something is wrong. Also I checked [CurrentRefinements#transformItems](https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/blob/v2/packages/react-instantsearch/src/components/CurrentRefinements.js#L16) because maybe I can use this method for make a workaround but currently is not being used in the implementation. Do you think that is a bug? I saw that because also I want to avoid this case: boom.type → "Boom Type"

I'm not sure to follow you entirely on your first point. 

`transformItems` is used by the connector. Our widgets are using under the hood our connectors. 
If you're using the props and modify the list of items, then the modification should be taken into account. Did you try it?

React InstantSearch has been moved here: https://github.com/algolia/react-instantsearch
This issue has either been rewritten or placed inside our backlog.
